cancel.title: Cancel booking
cancel.freeWindowNote: You can still cancel free of charge. We will return the amount paid as hour credit on your Clutchzone account — added on your next visit.
cancel.freeWindowNoCreditNote: You can still cancel free of charge. The amount you paid will be returned — we will e-mail you to arrange it.
cancel.freeWindowRefundNote: You can still cancel free of charge. This is a flat-rate time pass, so instead of hour credit we return the full {amount} CZK to your payment card. We will process it within 14 days.
cancel.lateNote: Less than {minutes} minutes remain before the start. Under the terms the amount paid is forfeited, but you can still cancel to free the station for someone else.
cancel.startedNote: This booking has already started or passed. The amount paid is forfeited, but you can still close it and free the station.
cancel.unpaidNote: This reservation hasn't been paid — you were due to pay at the club, so nothing is returned and nothing is forfeited. Cancelling simply frees the seat for someone else.
cancel.awaitingPaymentNote: This reservation hasn't been paid yet — it's waiting for the card payment. If the payment never arrives it will expire on its own and the station will be released. Cancelling releases it right away.
cancel.creditBookingNote: There is nothing to pay for this booking — hours come off your account only for the time you actually play. If you cannot make it, please cancel: otherwise we cannot hold the station and will offer it to someone else.
cancel.refundRequestLabel: Refund to my payment card instead of account credit (processed within 14 days).
cancel.cancelled: Your booking has been cancelled. The station is free again.
cancel.creditNote: We will add {hours} h to your account — just mention it at reception on your next visit.
cancel.creditUnrecordedNote: Your booking is cancelled, but we could not record the credit automatically. Please contact us at info@clutchzone.cz and we will add it manually.
cancel.refundRequestedNote: We have recorded your request for a card refund and will process it within 14 days.
cancel.genericError: Something went wrong. Please try again or give us a call.
cancel.invalidBody: This link is invalid or has expired. Please contact us by phone or email to cancel your booking.
cancel.notFoundBody: We could not find this booking. Please check the link in your email or get in touch.

withdraw.title: Withdraw from contract
withdraw.eligibleNote: You may withdraw within {days} days of purchase without giving a reason, because the purchased hours have not yet been credited or used. We will refund the amount to the payment card you used.
withdraw.expiredNote: The {days}-day withdrawal period has passed. If you still believe you are entitled to withdraw, please get in touch.
withdraw.fulfilledNote: The purchased hours have already been credited to your account, so withdrawal cannot be completed online. Write to us and we will settle it individually — you will get the unused portion back.
withdraw.ineligibleNote: This order cannot be withdrawn online. Please contact us by email and we will sort it out.
withdraw.refundNote: The money goes back to the card you paid with. It usually appears within a few working days.
withdraw.refundFailedNote: We recorded your withdrawal, but the automatic refund failed. We will refund you manually and be in touch — within 14 days at the latest.
withdraw.genericError: Something went wrong. Please try again or write to us.
